title: Phylactery Unbound
description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]5[/blue]. At the start of your turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]2[/blue].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic summons units to aid the player in combat. It triggers summon effects twice per turn cycle: first when combat begins (5 summons), then at the start of each player turn (2 summons). The relic's spawning behavior is indicated by SpawnsPets being set to true.
